description: This is a Java class for managing user accounts within the Android application, specifically handling the retrieval, deletion, and selection of accounts, as well as counting unsynchronized notes related to an account. It acts as a ViewModel in the Android architecture, connecting the UI with the data repository.

classes.name: ManageAccountsViewModel
classes.description: An Android ViewModel that manages user accounts for the Notes app, providing functionalities to retrieve the current account, list all accounts, delete an account, select an account, and count unsynchronized notes.

methods.name: ManageAccountsViewModel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the repository and prepares the ViewModel.

methods.name: getCurrentAccount
methods.description: Retrieves the current account asynchronously, invoking callback with success or error.

methods.name: getAccounts$
methods.description: Returns LiveData of the list of accounts, emitting only distinct changes.

methods.name: deleteAccount
methods.description: Deletes the specified account and automatically selects a neighboring account if available.

methods.name: selectAccount
methods.description: Sets the current account in the helper, or clears selection if null.

methods.name: countUnsynchronizedNotes
methods.description: Counts unsynchronized notes for a given account asynchronously.
